Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_064026.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_064026.v · Open raw
module origen_064026(
    input clk_50M,
    input reset_n,
    input write,
    input [7:0] write_control,
    input [15:0] write_addr,
    input [7:0] write_value,
    output reg write_complete,
    inout i2c_sda,
    output reg i2c_scl
);

    reg [31:0] data;
    reg [5:0] cnt;
    reg [2:0] i;
    reg [1:0] ii;
    reg [4:0] state;
    reg sda_out;

    assign i2c_sda = sda_out ? 1'bz : 1'b0;

    always @(posedge clk_50M or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n) begin
            state <= 0;
            cnt <= 0;
            i <= 0;
            ii <= 0;
            i2c_scl <= 1;
            sda_out <= 1;
            write_complete <= 0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                0: begin // Idle/Initialization
                    if (write) begin
                        data <= {write_control, write_addr, write_value};
                        state <= 1;
                        cnt <= 0;
                    end
                end
                1: begin // Start Condition
                    if (cnt == 10) begin
                        sda_out <= 0;
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end else if (cnt == 20) begin
                        i2c_scl <= 0;
                        state <= 2;
                        cnt <= 0;
                        i <= 0;
                        ii <= 0;
                    end else begin
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end
                end
                2: begin // Data Transmission
                    if (cnt == 10) begin
                        i2c_scl <= 1;
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end else if (cnt == 20) begin
                        i2c_scl <= 0;
                        i <= i + 1;
                        if (i == 7) begin
                            state <= 3;
                            sda_out <= 1;
                        end
                        cnt <= 0;
                    end else if (cnt == 0) begin
                        sda_out <= data[31-i-ii*8];
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end else begin
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end
                end
                3: begin // ACK
                    if (cnt == 10) begin
                        i2c_scl <= 1;
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end else if (cnt == 20) begin
                        i2c_scl <= 0;
                        ii <= ii + 1;
                        if (ii == 3) begin
                            state <= 4;
                        end else begin
                            state <= 2;
                            i <= 0;
                        end
                        cnt <= 0;
                    end else begin
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end
                end
                4: begin // Stop Condition
                    if (cnt == 10) begin
                        i2c_scl <= 1;
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end else if (cnt == 20) begin
                        sda_out <= 1;
                        state <= 0;
                        write_complete <= 1;
                        cnt <= 0;
                    end else begin
                        cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
